Most of my durable, public-facing teaching and software resources live on
the two public course sites. This page is the index.

## Public course resources

- [Math Software · Resources](/math-software/resources/) — software setup,
  AI-use guidelines, CAS options, and small reproducibility guides.
- [Intro Stats · Resources](/intro-stats/resources/) — readings, R
  primers, and outside links for an introductory statistics course.

Both sites carry their own notes, labs, and example pages alongside the
resource collections above.

## Planned resources

A short list of standalone writeups I expect to land here over time:

- A minimal Quarto setup for academic writing.
- A short, opinionated Git workflow for solo academic work.
- A reproducible-project template for small statistical analyses.
- Notes on responsible use of AI assistants in mathematical and
  statistical work.

These will appear on this page when they are ready; until then, the
linked course-site resources cover most of the same ground.
